data.why: The repo ships sample_blot.tif, a synthetic 3-lane x 3-row Western blot (plus make_sample_blot.py to regenerate it) built specifically to exercise upload, detection, normalization, and export.

goals: Upload a blot scan and straighten/deskew it using the alignment grid before detection
Review and correct auto-detected band ROIs per lane, including faint bands and doublets
Quantify band intensity via background-corrected integrated density and check for saturation
Normalize each target against a loading control (e.g. GAPDH) in the same lane
Aggregate replicates into mean +/- SD/SEM/95% CI and run an optional t-test/ANOVA
Export a publication-ready bar chart (PNG/TIFF/SVG/PDF) plus the underlying CSV/XLSX data

review.summary: The goal and phases match BlotGrid's stated purpose and six-tab workflow closely, the depth is right, and the sampled screens mostly show what the nodes say. Before filing it needs the replicate task reframed around setting replicate numbers, review of flagged regions and project restore added, and the weakly evidenced resize and export actions fixed.
